snippet.title: SOLEMNFABLE REVEAL TRAILER | Journey of Acceptance
snippet.description:
WITNESS FORGIVENESS in SOLEMNFABLE, releasing 10.16.26!

SOLEMNFABLE is a QTE centered turn-based RPG, following Callisto as they leave their home for the first time, finally getting to fulfill their life's purpose.

WISHLIST NOW!!!!!!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5007740/SOLEMNFABLE/

And learn more here:
https://solemnfable.nekoweb.org/

--

Trailer art by washbearzz
https://twitter.com/washbearzz
https://ko-fi.com/washbearzz

Storyboarding by beddybyekitty
https://twitter.com/dreamtdebris
https://beddybyekitty.bandcamp.com

Music by... me!
https://napcast.nekoweb.org
https://planetnapcast.tumblr.com

--

Keep an eye out on the SOLEMNFABLE social media pages for more news.
https://twitter.com/solemnfable
https://solemnfable.tumblr.com

--

Until next time,

- Robin
